sup:70410.subject: Mechanical seal 24 mm – firm full-volume package from 2027
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. You have said you will prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments, so we would like to offer exactly that.

We propose the following package: EUR 28.40/unit, 23,400 units/year, 24 months, 56 days lead time, DAP, 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01. If the package is agreed, the full annual quantity is binding.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); this is not a claim about your actual cost or margin.

If this package needs approval as a commercial exception, would you be willing to sponsor it with your manager? We would gladly support your internal business case with this firm commitment.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Mechanical seal 24 mm – firm full-volume package from 2027
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your proposal for a firm commitment of 23,400 units over 24 months. Your target price is not feasible; however, we can accommodate the requested volume and contract duration. We therefore offer a revised price of EUR 31.70 per unit for this package.

Our Angebot is a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. It remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Revised package: 36-month firm commitment for the 24 mm mechanical seal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for confirming you can cover the full volume and for taking our cost estimate into account.

To meet you, we are raising our price from EUR 28.40 to EUR 30.90/unit and adding a third committed year. The package is EUR 30.90/unit, 23,400 units/year, 36 months, 56 days lead time, DAP, 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01. The full annual quantity would be binding for all three years.

Your supplier-wide rolling on-time delivery was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3); we ask for commercial recognition of this service record in the package.

If you can approve this complete package, we are ready to conclude on it.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Revised package: 36-month firm commitment for the 24 mm mechanical seal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your proposal for a 36-month commitment. The referenced delivery record has been reviewed but does not warrant a commercial adjustment. Consequently, we can offer a revised price of EUR 31.40 per unit for this package. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot comprises a price of €31.40 per unit, a Lieferzeit of 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer remains valid for 7 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.
